messages:
incident-bot: Planned event: weekend drain drill starting in ~15m for eu-west1 serving nodes. Pager signal will fire at T+10m as a drill. This is a non-customer-impact exercise but treat alerts as real for ops practice. :robot_face:

maya (oncall): copying. I'll be on the bridge. tagging @jordan for runtime ops readiness.

jordan (sre): I'm available. quick check: are we doing a staged drain (by AZ) or full region warm drain?

maya (oncall): staged by AZ, 5m stagger. aim is to validate fallback routing and statuspage automation.

sasha (support): heads-up: CS inbox has a few customers scheduled with high-traffic jobs this weekend. Lia - can you flag any that need pre-notify?

lia (customer-success): flagged two customers (AcmeCorp, HealthFlow). I'll draft a short advisory and wait for ops signoff.

kevin (eng-runtime): runtime note: we've applied the patch that fixes KV eviction ordering. We'll monitor tail-latency during the drain. If we see >2x  p95 we'll trigger rollback.

incident-bot: Pager signal: test-alert /drill fired by automation at 1797201165 - status ROUTED -> ONCALL.

maya (oncall): acknowledged. engaging canary routing. running smoke checks on embed and generation endpoints.

jordan (sre): seeing small increase in seq-length 95th for long-tail jobs, within expected for staged drain. No errors yet.

kevin (eng-runtime): starting detailed tracing capture for the affected nodes (keeps small perf overhead). dropping logs to /var/logs/drain-drill/1797201110.log

lia (customer-success): draft customer advisory for AcmeCorp: "We are running a routine maintenance drill in eu-west1 this weekend to validate failover behavior. You should not experience downtime; if you do, reply and we’ll escalate immediately." Posting to CS for review.

sasha (support): looks good. Add contact link + incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/preview (internal link).

incident-bot: automation note: statuspage draft created: "eu-west1 maintenance drill — no customer impact expected". Please review before public publish.

maya (oncall): decision: DO NOT publish publicly unless we see real customer impact. Lia keep CS pre-notify for the two customers only. Jordan keep me posted on any error spikes.

jordan (sre): error rate 5xx still nominal. routing fallback exercised successfully for AZ-2.

kevin (eng-runtime): noticed a single pod mis-registered to control-plane during the drain; I pushed a quick reconcile script. Re-registration succeeded at +180s. No customer sessions lost.

lia (customer-success): AcmeCorp replied asking for a scheduled ETA. I messaged them with the pre-approved text and the contingency contact.

sasha (support): customers on CS channel confirm no visible impact so far.

incident-bot: follow-up event: Pager signal resolved at 1797201300 - status RESOLVED (drill complete for AZ-2).

maya (oncall): proceeding to next AZ. Jordan, keep close watch on p50/p95.

jordan (sre): next AZ drain succeeded. small latency blip at +12s then normalized. No 5xx delta.

kevin (eng-runtime): rolling metrics capture done. uploading trace bundle: s3://redwood-ops/drain-drills/1797201110/trace-bundle.zip

lia (customer-success): sent final note to AcmeCorp and HealthFlow: "Drill completed without customer impact. Reach out if you saw anything unexpected."

sasha (support): marking CS ticket as "info-only" and closing.

maya (oncall): wrap: drill complete for eu-west1. No customer impact. Next steps: 1) incident-runbook note with timeline, 2) attach trace bundle, 3) recommend small follow-up RFC re: reconcile script to avoid transient re-registration. I'll file the postmortem entry.

incident-bot: Maintenance notice: Marking thread CLOSED at 1797201425. Reminder: if any customer reports impact in next 2 hours, reopen and escalate. :white_check_mark:"
